## Method 1: simstudy

```{r}
library(simstudy)
set.seed(1965)

def <- defData(varname="x", formula = 10, variance = 2, dist = "normal")
def <- defData(def, varname="y", formula = "3 + 0.5 * x", variance = 1, dist = "normal")
dd <- genData(250, def)

dd <- trtAssign(dd, nTrt = 4, grpName = "grp", balanced = TRUE)

dd
```
